explanation: For each neighboring word pair, add the first differing character's ordering edge; reject a longer word before its own prefix. Topologically sort all seen characters and reject cycles.
timeComplexity: O((W + S + V + E) log(V+1)) conservative upper bound using ordered maps/sets, for W words, S characters, V symbols and E distinct edges.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
